fee_notes: Standard Franchise Fee is $50,000, paid in two installments of $25,000 each: first at signing of Preliminary Agreement, second within 30 days after Opening Date. A military veteran's discount reduces the fee to $25,000 (available to veterans with non-dishonorable discharge and active-duty personnel, requires DD-214 form). No reduced fees were received from non-qualifying new FBOs during fiscal year ending December 31, 2025.
raw_excerpt: You will pay us a Franchise Fee of $50,000 in two installments: (i) $25,000 when you sign a Preliminary Agreement with us and (ii) $25,000 within 30 days after the opening date of your Franchise Branch (the "Opening Date")... If you qualify for our military veteran's discount, your Franchise Fee will be reduced to $25,000, and you will be required to pay the full Franchise Fee at the same time an FBO that does not qualify for our military veteran's discount is required to pay the first installment of the Franchise Fee.
